subject: W7 interactive cluster landed as PR #293: model roster, credential setup, doctor repair reachable from the palette
result: Completed W7s interactive half, stacked on the disclosure work. PR #293 (base agent/wave7-system-rest / #292) carries three commits, each reusing an existing palette pattern. (1) Model roster overlay: PaletteBackend::model_roster() composes the ranked roster on Service from the compose paths resolved model_routes (rank_model_roster over candidates_from_routes), fetched on demand and cached; Ctrl+R opens Overlay::ModelRoster via RequestModelRoster->LoadModelRoster effect->ModelRosterLoaded (mirrors W6 live-field fetch), rendered with the existing model_roster_matrix; a non-Project composes None. TuiState/UiAction/TuiReduction dropped Eq (ModelRoster is only PartialEq due to ranking floats; nothing needed Eq). (2)+(3) Credential setup + doctor repair via the launcher idiom: Ctrl+E/Ctrl+D set an ExitIntent (guarded by the same staged-changes check as Exit), the surface maps it to PaletteOutcome::RunCredentialSetup/RunDoctorFix, and main.rs runs the flow on the restored terminal. Setup reads the worlds unbound credentials from credential_requirements_for_model_routes, lists them, runs the shared interactive credential::setup. Repair runs the same diff-first ProcedureRunner engine as doctor --fix (plan->diff->ask->apply->undo affordance); usually nothing is auto-fixable (plan_fixes only creates missing home dirs) but the wiring is correct. System footer names all three controls. Tests: reducer (roster load/open/dismiss; exit intents; staged-changes guard), Service producer against a real Project (real ranked roster; non-Project None; cached; decorator forward). Full cargo test -p aikit-core -p aikit-tui -p aikit-cli green; clippy clean. W7 status: the System pane now both discloses the whole installation (#290 credentials, #292 health/gateway/workcell/adapters) and makes its interactive surfaces reachable (#293). What the ticket lists beyond this is W3s session-start contract (blocked on #227) and W9/W10 (separate waves). Stack: #290->#292->#293, all off unmerged bases awaiting owner review; retarget on merge. Worktree wt-w7b kept.
